questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question tests practical CNF provenance enforcement from build to runtime with per-tenant controls and a low-risk rollout.

## Key Concepts
- Build provenance in image labels (commit SHA, CI job, build ID)
- Cosign signing with a KMS-backed key
- SPDX SBOM attachment and verification
- Gatekeeper/OPA policy enforcing provenance presence
- Namespace-scoped testing and rollback strategy

## Code Example
```yaml
# Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate skeleton
apiVersion: templates.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: ConstraintTemplate
metadata:
  name: k8sprovenance
spec:
  crd:
    spec:
      names:
        kind: ProvenanceConstraint
  targets:
  - target: admission.k8s.gatekeeper.sh
    rego: |
      package provenance
      # placeholder policy
```

```bash
# Minimal test commands
kubectl create namespace test-ns
# deploy CNF, then verify policy & logs
kubectl apply -n test-ns -f cnf-deploy.yaml
kubectl get events -n test-ns | grep provenance
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you adapt the workflow for a canary rollout?
- How would you monitor policy violations at scale?

Tests resilience isolation, tenant RBAC, and end-to-end chaos execution in CNF gateways. Demands practical familiarity with LitmusChaos, CRDs, and debugging cross-tenant faults.

## Key Concepts
- Namespace isolation and RBAC for chaos tooling

```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: tenant-chaos-admin
  namespace: tenant-ns
rules:
- apiGroups: ["litmuschaos.io"]
  resources: ["chaosexperiments","chaosexperiments/status","chaosengines","chaosengines/status"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch","create","delete","patch","update"]
```
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: tenant-chaos-admin-binding
  namespace: tenant-ns
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: chaos-sa
  namespace: tenant-ns
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: tenant-chaos-admin
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```
```yaml
apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
kind: ChaosExperiment
metadata:
  name: cpu-stress
  namespace: tenant-ns
spec:
  definition:

      - "-duration=30s"
```

```yaml
kind: ChaosEngine
metadata:

  - name: cpu-stress
```

```yaml
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gw
  namespace: tenant-ns
spec:
  replicas: 1

---

kind: ChaosEngine
metadata:
  name: test-engine
  namespace: tenant-ns
spec:
  chaosServiceAccount: chaos-sa
  experiments:
  - name: cpu-stress
```

```yaml
# Kyverno policy skeleton enforcing provenance fields
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy

  name: cnf-provenance-policy
spec:
  rules:
  - name: enforce-cosign-sbom
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: ["Deployment","StatefulSet"]
    validate:
      message: "Image must be Cosign-signed and SBOM-present"
      pattern:
        spec:
          template:
            spec:
              containers:
              - image: "*"
```

```yaml
kind: Namespace

  name: tenant-a
```
